no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee meeting was not held for this NDA.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for DUAVEE (NDA022247). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review states plainly that "An Advisory Committee meeting was not held for this NDA," and the Summary Review explains the NDA "was not taken to advisory committee" because reviewers "did not identify efficacy or safety issues that needed input from an advisory panel." With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
